items.text: Abraham’ Tapa David, David’ Tapa Yahshua Messiah khang simna ahi hi.
Abraham’ tapa Isaac, Isaac’ tapa Yaaqob, Yaaqob’ tapa Yahdah leh a sanggam pasal sawmlekhatte ahi hi.
Yahdah in a tapa’ zi Tamar tawh a neih Perez leh Zerah hi a, Perez’ tapa Hezron, Hezron’ tapa Ram ahi hi.
Ram’ tapa Amminadab, Amminadob’ tapa Nahshon, Nahshon’ tapa Salmon ahi hi.
Salmon in Rachab tawh a neih a tapa Boaz, Boaz in Riyyah tawh a neih a tapa Obed leh Obed’ tapa Yishai ahi hi.
Yishai’ tapa kumpi David, kumpi David in Uriyah’ zi ahi ngei Bathsheba tawh a neih Solomon ahi hi.
Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam, Rehoboam’ tapa Abiyah, Abiyah’ tapa Asa ahi hi.
Asa’ tapa Yahshaphat, Yahshaphat’ tapa Yahram, Yahram’ tapa Uzzyah (Azaryah) ahi hi.
Uzzyah’ (Azarah) tapa Yahtham, Yahtham’ tapa Ahaz, Ahaz’ tapa Hezeleyah ahi hi.
Hezekyah’ tapa Menasheh, Menasheh’ tapa Amon, Amon’ tapa Yoshiyah ahi hi.
Yoshiyah’ tapa Yahyakin leh a sanggam pasalte hi a, tua hunin Babylon ah amaute salin kipaipih hi.
Babylon ah a kipaipih khit ciangin Yahyahkin in tapa Shealtiel (Pedayah) leh Zerubbabel (Babylon) a nei hi.
Zerubbabel’ tapa Abiud, Abiud’ tapa Ylyakim, Ylyakim’ tapa Azor ahi hi.
Azor’ tapa Zadok, Zadok’ tapa Yahyakim, Yahyakim’ tapa Yliud ahi hi.
Yliud’ tapa Yleazar, Yleazar’ tapa Matthan, Matthan’ tapa Yaaqob ahi hi. (Yaaqob in Messiah kici Yahshua a hong suahna Miriam’ pasal Yahseph kici tapa a nei hi.)
Yaaqob’ tapa Yahseph hi a, Yahseph pen Messiah kici Yahshua a hong suahna Miriam’ pasal ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Abraham panin David dong a suan khempeuh khang sawm le khang li hi a, David panin Babylon ah saltan hun dong khang sawm le khang li, Babylon saltun hun panin Messiah dong khang sawm le khang li mah ahi hi.
Yahshua’ suahna
Tu-in Yahshua Messiah hong suahzia hih bang ahi hi: A nu Miriam pen Yahseph aa dingin zuthawl kipiasa hi a, a omkhop ma-un Kha Siangtho hangin nau nei ahi hi.
Tua hi a, a pasal Yahseph pen a thutang mi hi a, a zi maizum nadingin pholak nuam lo ahih manin a sim thamin maksim ding a ngaihsun hi.

Ahih hangin hih thute a ngaihsut laitakin en in, a mang sungah Yahweh’ vantungmi kilang a, “David’ tapa Yahseph aw, na zi dingin Miriam la ngam lo kei in. Banghang hiam cihleh a sunga a paai nau pen Kha Siangtho tungtawnin a piang ahi hi.
Amah in Tapa khat nei ding a, a min YAHSHUA; Yahweh’ hotkhiatna, na phuak ding hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ama mite a mawhna panin honkhia ding hi.
Yahweh in kamsangpa tungtawnin a gensa thu a tangtung nadingin tu-in hih thute khempeuh a piang ahi hi. A genna ah:
“En un, nungak khat gai-in Tapa khat nei ding a, Immanuyah etsakna-in hong pai ding hi. Immauyah a khiatna in Eite tawh Vanglianpen Yahweh hong omkhawm cihna ahi hi.
Yahseph ihmu a khanlawh ciangin Yahweh’ vantungmi in a thupiakna bangin hih a, a zi dingin inn ah Miriam a ciahpih hi.
Ahih hangin tacil a suah khit mateng luppih lo a, a suah ciangin a min YAHSHUA a phuak hi.
Naungek kikan
Tu-in kumpi Herod hun Yahdah gam Bethlehem ah Yahshua a suah khit ciangin en in, nisuahna lam panin Yerusalem ah mipilte hong tung uh a,
“Yahdah mite kumpi dinga hong suakpa koiah om ahi hiam? Banghang hiam cihleh a taangkhia ama aksi ka mu uh a, amah bia dingin hong pai ka hi uh hi,” ci-in a kan uh hi.
Kumpi Herod in hih thu a zak ciangin kumpipa leh amah tawh a om Yerusalem khempeuh a patau uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in siampi liante khempeuh leh mipi lai-atte kaikhawmin, “Messiah koi teng ah suak ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Yahdah gam Bethlehem ah suak ding hi. Banghang hiam cihleh kamsangpa in hih bangin gelh hi:
Bethlehem Ephratah aw, Yahdah tul tampite lakah khuaneu khat na hih hangin, na sung panin ka mi Israyl-te a cing ding ukpa khat hong piang ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Herod in mipilte samsim a, amaute kiang panin aksi a kilat hun teltakin a mukhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Bethlehem ah amaute sawl a, “Pai unla, naupangno limtakin va zong un. Kei zong pai-in amah ka biak theih nadingin amah na muh uh ciangin kei kiangah hong zasak kik un,” a ci hi.
Amaute in kumpipa vaikhakna a zak khit uh ciangin paikhia uh hi. Tua ciangin a taangkhiat cilin a muh uh aksi pen naupangno omna tungsantak tungin a khawl masiah amaute maiah tua aksi a pai hi.
Amaute in aksi a muh uh ciangin nakpi-in a nuam uh hi.
Inn sungah a lut uh ciangin naupangno leh a nu mu uh a, bokin naupangno a bia uh hi. A van manphate uh suah khia-in, kham, paknamtui leh myrrh letsongin Amah pia uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Herod kiangah a pai kik nawn loh nadingun mang sungah genkhol ahih manin lampi dang tawnin amau gam ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Egypt ah Taina

Amaute a pai khit uh ciangin, en in, Yahweh’ vantungmi Yahseph mang sungah kilang a, “Tho in, naupangno leh a nu la inla, Egypt ah tai in. Herod in thah dingin naupangno zong dek ta ahih manin thu kong zaksak kik mateng tua laiah om in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah tho-in zanin Naupangno leh a nu la-in, Egypt ah a tai hi.
Tua hi a, Herod sih mateng tua laiah om uh hi. Yahweh in kamsangpa tungtawnin, “Egypt panin ka tapa ka sam hi,” ci-in a genna a tangtung ahi hi.

Mipilte in amah a khem lam Herod in a theih ciangin heh mahmah a, mipilte kiang panin a theih khiat hun tawh kizui-in Bethlehem leh a kimkot gam sunga om kum nih leh a nuaisiah pasalno khempeuh thah dingin thu a pia hi.
Tua hi a, kamsang Yeremyah gensa thu a tangtung hi.
“Ramah ah aw khat kiza a, tamlawhna leh nakpi-a kahna ahi hi. Rachel in a tate kah a, a tate om nawn lo ahih manin a tate hangin hehnep ding a ut kei hi”
Nazareth ah Ciahkikna
Herod a sih ciangin, en in, Egypt gam sunga om Yahseph kiangah a mangin Yahweh’ vantungmi kilang a,
“Tho in, naupangno leh a nu la inla, Israyl gam ah pai in. Banghang hiam cihleh naupangno’ nuntakna a zongte si ta uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah tho a, naupangno leh a nu la-in Israyl gam ah a pai hi.
Ahih hangin Archelaus in a pa Herod za luahin Yahdah gam a ukna thu a zak ciangin, tua laiah a pai ngam kei hi. Tua hi a, Yahweh in a mang sungah a genkholh mah bangin Galilee gam ah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah pai-in Nazareth khua ah a teng hi. “Amah Nazareth khua mi kici ding hi,” ci-in kamsangpa tungtawnin a kigensa thu a tangtung ahi hi.
Tuiphumpa Yahchanan’ Thuhilhna
Tua hunin Yahdah gam, gamlak ah Tuiphumpa Yahchanan thu hilhin pai a,
“Yahweh kumpigam hong nai ta ahih manin kisikkik un!” a ci hi.
Kamsangpa Isayah in, “Gamlak ah a kikopa awging in, ‘Yahweh pai nading lampi na sial unla, i Pa lam lianpi na tangsak un,’ ci hi,” ci-in a genpa in hih Yahchanan ahi hi.
Hih Yahchanan in kalaoh mul tawh a kigan puan silhin, savun kawnggak tawh a kawng gak a, kauphe leh gamlak khuaizu an-in a nei hi.
Tua ciangin Yerusalem leh Yahdah khempeuh, Yardan kimkot mun khempeuh panin mite ama kiangah a pai uh hi.
Amaute in amau mawhna ciat pulakin Yahchanan in Yardan Gun ah a tuiphum hi.
Ahih hangin Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te tampi ama tuiphumna ah a paina a muh ciangin, “Gul gupha’ suante aw, hong tung ding hehna panin na suahtak nadingun kua in hong hilhkhol ahi hiam?
Kisikkikna tawh a kilawm gahte na gah un.
Noleno, “Abraham i pa hi ngawn hi,” ci-in ngaihsun kha kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh ken kong cih inah, Yahweh in hih suangte panin Abraham aa ding tate a khangkhia sak thei hi!
Tua hi a, singkungte a phung ah hei kinga gige zo hi. Tua ahih manin gah hoih a gah lo kung peuhmah kisattan ding a, mei sungah kikhul hi.

Hi hi, kisikkikna hangin tui tawh note kong baptize a, ahih hangin kei khit ciangin hong paipa kei sangin vanglianzaw a, Ama khedap tawi dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi. Amah in Kha Siangtho ahih keileh mei tawh note hong baptize ding hi.
Ama khut sungah ansi zapna om a, Amah in buhcilna tual hahsiangin, ansal sungah a buhte khol ding hi. Ahih hangin amah in a mit ngei lo meikuang tawh ansite haltum ding hi.
Yahshua kituiphumna
Galilee panin Yardan ah Yahchanan kiangah tui kiphum dingin Yahshua pai hi.
Ahih hangin Yahchanan in, “Nangma tuiphum ding kei a kisamzaw kimlai, kei kiangah hong pai zawsop na hi hiam?” ci-in a nial hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Thumaan khempeuh a tangtun nadingin ei aa ding a kilawm ahih manin hong phal in,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin Yahchanan in mang hi.
Yahshua tui a kiphum khit ciangin, tui sung panin a dingto pah hi. Tua ciangin en in, vantungte kihong a, Yahweh’ Kha kumsukin, Ama sungah a lut lam a thei hi.
Tua ciangin vantung panin aw khat in, “Hih in ka lung hong kimsak mahmah, ka it ka tapa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Satan in Yahshua Ze-et
Tua ciangin dawi ze-etna a thuak dingin gamlak ah Kha in a paipih hi.
Amah in sun sawmli leh zan sawmli an a tan khit ciangin a gil kial hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah a ze-etpa va pai-in, “Yahweh’ Tapa na hih leh, hih suangte anlum a suah nadingin thupia in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “Hih bangin kigelh hi: An bek tawh mihing a nungta hilo a, Yahweh’ kam panin a pusuak thu khempeuh tawh a nungta hi zaw hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin dawi in khuapi siangtho sungah lutpih a, Yahweh Inn a siangtho khumzang dawnah a koih hi.

Tua ciangin Ama kiangah, “Yahweh’ Tapa na hihleh lengsuk in. Banghang hiam cihleh na lampi khempeuh ah nang hong kem dingin Yahweh in nangma thu ah a vantungmite thu neihna a pia ding hi. Na khe leh suang a kitah khak loh nadingin amaute in a khut tawh hong domto ding hi, ci-in kigelh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Yahweh na Pa na ze-et kei ding hi, ci-in kigelh hi,” a ci hi.
Dawi in a sang mahmah mualtung khat ah paipih leuleu a, leitung kumpigam khempeuh leh tuate thupitna lakin,
Ama kiangah, “Ka maiah hong kunin kei hong bia lecin, hih nate khempeuh nang kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Paikhia in, Satan! Banghang hiam na cihleh Yahweh na Pa na zahtak ding a, ama na bek na sem ding hi! ci-in kigelh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin dawi in taisan a, en in, vantung mite hong pai-in amah a don hi.
Tu-in tuiphum Yahchanan thong sungah a kikoihna thu Yahshua in a zak ciangin Galilee ah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Nazareth nusia-in, Zebulun leh Naphtali gam huam tuipi gei Copernaum ah pai-in a teng hi.
Kamsang Isayah tungtawnin a kigen thu a tangtun nading ahi hi. A gen inah,
“Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam, tuipi lamdung kiang, Yardan gal, Gentile mite tenna Galilee ah,
Khuamial ah a pai mite in khuavak lianpi mu khin uh a, sihna liim gam sungah a tengte tungah khuavak in taan khin hi.”
Tua hun-a kipanin Yahshua thuhilh ding kipan a, “Kisikkik un. Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh kumpigam hong nai ta hi,” a ci hi.
Nga beng lite kisam
Galilee tuipi geiah Yahshua a pai laitakin, Kepha kici Simon leh a sanggampa Andrew, unau nih a mu hi. Amaute sum zonna nga beng nasep ahih manin tuipi sungah ngen a khuh uh hi.
Amah in, “Ka nung hong zui un, nga mat bangin mi mante kong suaksak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a ngen uh nusia pahin, Yahshua a zui uh hi.
Tua panin pai-in, a pa uh Zabdyah tawh gunkuang sungah ngen khui-in a om, Zabdyah tapate ahi Yaaqob leh a sanggampa Yahchanan a kici unau nih mu a, Yahshua in amaute a sam hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a gunkuang leh a pa uh nusia pahin, Yahshua a zui uh hi.
Mi tampi damsakna
Tua ciangin Galilee gam sung khempeuh ah Yahshua pai kawikawi-in amau biakinn sung ah thu hilh a, Kumpigam lungdamna thu tangko-in mite laka om cinatna namkim leh natna nam khempeuh a damsak hi.

Tua ciangin Syria gamsung khempeuh ah Ama thu a thang hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in cina khempeuh: damlohna leh natna tuamtuam a thuak-te, dawilutte, a sibuptheite leh pumzawte ama kiangah paipih uh a, Yahshua in amaute a damsak hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee pan, Decapolis pan, Yerusalem pan, Yahdah pan leh Yardan gungal panin mihon tampi in Yahshua a zui uh hi.
Tu-in Yahshua in mihonpite a muh ciangin, mual tungah paito-in a tu hi. A nungzuite ama kiangah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Amah kamkakhia-in thu hilhin a gen inah:
A lunggim mite, haksatna thuakin, a ki niamkhiat mite, thupha ngah mi ahi hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh Kumpigam amaute aa ahi hi.
A dah a kapte thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute kihehnem ding hi.
A lungnem mite thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in leitung luah ding uh hi.
Thumaanna hangin a gilkial a dangtaak mite thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute kigilvahsak ding hi.
Mi hehpih theite thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang cihleh amaute in hehpihna a ngah ding uh hi.
A lungsim siangthote thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in Yahweh mu ding uh hi.
Kilemna a bawl mite thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute Yahweh’ tate kici ding hi.
Thumaanna hangin bawlsiatna a thuakte thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh Kumpigam amaute aa ahi hi.
Keima hangin mite in hong ko-in, hong bawlsia-in, a man lopi-in thusia namkim tawh hong gensiat uh ciangin note thupha ngah mi na hi uh hi.
Vantung ah na thaman uh lian mahmah ahih manin nuamin, nakpi-in kipaakun. Banghang hiam cihleh note hun ma-in kamsangte zong amaute in tua mah bangin bawlsia uh hi.

Note pen leitung mite aa dingin ci na hi uh hi. Ahih hangin ci a alna bei leh, bangci bangin ki-alkiksak thei ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin mite khe nuaiah tuatcil dingin paih ding simloh bangmahin a kimang nawn kei hi.
Note pen leitung mite aa dingin khuavak na hi uh hi. Mual tunga kisat khuapi kiseel thei lo hi.
Tua hi a, mite in zong meivak vakin lawh khuh ngeilo a, meivak khuam tungah koihin inn sunga om khempeuh khuavak a pia hi.
Mite maiah na khuavak uh tangsak un. Tua hi leh amaute in na gamtat hoihna uh mu-in, vantunga om na Pa uh a phat ding uh hi.
Thukham ahi a, kamsangte’ thugente ahi zongin a susia dingin hong pai hi, ci-in hong ngaihsun peuhmah kei un. Tuate a susia dingin hong pai ka hi kei a, a kipsak dingin hong pai ka hizaw hi.
A man takpi kong cih inah: vantung leh leitung a bei zongin na khempeuh a bukim khit mateng laimal lak pana neupen “yodh” khat zong thukham panin a mangthang kei ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih thukhamte lak panin a neupen khat palsatin, mite zong tua bangin a palsat nadingin a hilh mi peuhmah, Yahweh Kumpigam sungah mi neupen kici ding hi. Ahi zongin thukhamte zui-in mite in zong a zuih nadingin a hilh mi peuhmah Yahweh Kumpigam sungah mi lian kici ding hi.
Tua hi a, ken kong cih inah: note thumaanna in lai-atte leh Pharisee-te’ thumaanna a khenzawh keileh, Yahweh Kumpigam sungah na lut kha peuhmah kei ding ahi hi.
Lungsim sungah mi thatna- Muhdahna
‘Mi na that kei ding uh hi. Mi a that peuhmah in thukhenna a thuak ding hi,” ci-in tanglai mite gensa thu na zaksa uh ahi hi.

Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah: A sanggampa tungah a heh mi peuhmah in thukenna thuak ding hi. Tua banah a sanggampa kiangah, “Raca; Bangmah-a kimang lopa,” ci-in a ko bawl mi in thusitna thuak ding a, a sanggampa kiangah, “Nabel” ci-in a phuisam mi in Gehenna meikuang thuak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin biaknatau ah biakna pia dingin na om laitakin, na sanggampa nang tungah hong lungkim lohna khatpeuh na theih leh,
biaknatau maiah na biakpiaknate nusia phot inla, na sanggampa kiangah pai masa-in kilem phot in. Tua khit ciangin paikik inla, na biakna pia pan in.

Thukhen zum hong tut ma-in nang hong mawhsakpa tawh manlang in kilem pak in. Tua bang hi keileh na langpa in thukhente tungah hong pia-in, thukhente in thuneite tungah hong apin, thong sung hong kitun kha ding hi.
Ken a man takin kong cih inah: Na liausum a vekin na piak khit mateng tua lai panin na suakta ngei kei ding hi.
“Nulepa mawna na bawl kei ding uh hi,” ci-in tanglai mite genna thu na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah: lunggulhna tawn numei khat a en mi peuhmah, tua nu tawh a lungsim sungah a mawh khin ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin na taklam mit in mawhna a piansak leh khelkhia inla na kiang panin paai in! Banghang hiam cihleh Gehenna ah na pumpi bup a tun ding sangin na pumpi nate khat a kisiat ding nang aa dingin hoihzaw hi.
Na taklam khut in mawhna a piansak leh, tankhia inla na kiang panin paai in! Banghang hiam cihleh Gehenna ah na pumpi bup a tun ding sangin na pumpi nate khat a kisiat ding nang aa dingin hoihzaw hi.
“A zi a ma peuhmah in kimakna lai pia tahen,” kici hi.

Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah, pasal dang tawh mawhna simloh a zi a ma mi peuhmah in a zi mi dang tawh a mawh dingin a bawl ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a kimasa numei a teenpih mi peuhmah nulepa mawhna a bawl ahi hi.

Tua ban ah, “Yahweh tungah mi khat a kiciam ciang ahih keileh amah a khih kiciamna khatpeuh a kiciam ciangin, amah in a ciamsa thu palsat lo ding hi. Amah in hih ding ci-in a gensa thu khempeuh ahih loh phamawh hi,” ci-in tanglai mite thugen na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah: Kiciamnate tawh kikhih nawn kei un! Vantung pen Yahweh tokhom ahih manin kiciamna-in vantung na zong kei un.
Leitung pen a khe ngakna ahih manin leitung zong kiciamna-in na zang kei un. Yerusalem pen a lian Kumpipa khuapi ahih manin Yerusalem zong kiciamna-in na zang kei un.
Kiciamna-in na lutang uh zong na zang kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh na samzang khat uh zong na kangsak na vomsak thei kei uh hi.

Ahih zongin kamciam piak uh ciangin, thute “hi” nasak thute “hi mah” ci unla, kamciam na piak loh uh ciangin, “hi” nasak loh thute “Hilo” ci un. Hih valin genna khatpeuh pen gilopa kiang pana pai ahi hi.
“Mittang khat tangin mittang khat, hatang khat tangin hatang khat,” ci-in a kigenna thu na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah: Mi gilote na thukkik kei in. Na paang langkhat hong kibet leh a langkhat zong dawhzaw in.
Mi khatpeuh in na puanak hong laksak nop manin thukhen zum ah thu hong bawl nop leh, na puantungsilh zong na pia in.
Zawhthawh thu tawh tai khat hong pai pihte, tai nih dong na zui in.
Hong ngente pia inla, nang kiang panin hong leitawi nuamte nungheisan kei in.
“Na sanggampa na it ding uh a, ahih hangin na galte na mudah ding uh hi,” ci-in a kigenna thu na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah: Na galte uh it unla, hong samsiate thupha pia-in, hong mudahte tungah a hoihin gamta unla, hong simmawhte leh hong bawlsiate aa dingin thu na ngetsak un.

Tua hileh vantunga om na Pa uh tate na hi thei ding uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Amah in migilote leh midikte tungah a ni tangsak tuak a, thutang mite tung leh a thutang lo mite tungah a guah zukhawm sak hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh no hong itte bek it le-uh cin, bang thaman ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Siah dongte na ngawn in zong amau a itte it uh hi.
Tua hi a, na sanggamte bek uh muak le-uh cin midangte sangin na hoihzawkna uh bang om ding ahi hiam? Siahdongte nangawn zong tua bangin gamta uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin vantunga om na Pa uh a hoihkim mah bangin note na hoihkim un.
Mi muh theihtheih ding bekin mite maiah biakna tawh kipawl mi cimawhte a huh na hih loh nadingun kidawm un. Tua bang hi keileh vantunga om na Pa uh kiang panin thaman na ngah kei ding uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin biak tawh kisai-in cimawh huhnate na piak uh ciangin, mite kiang panin minpha ngah nadingin biakinn sung leh kong zing lak khawng ah kineihkhem mite sep bangin na mai uh ah peengkul awsau; teki’ah, mut kei un.
Ahih hangin cimawh huhna na piak uh ciangin na taklam khut tawh na piakte uh na veilam khut theisak kei un.
Tua hileh na huhnate uh a simtham-a kipia hi ding a, a simtham thute a mu na Pa un a kilang takin thaman hong pia ding hi.

Tua hi a, thu na nget uh ciangin a kineihkhem mite bangin na om kei ding uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in mi muh theihtheih dingin biakinn sung leh kongzing lamkabom tengah dingin thunget nuam sa uh hi. Ken a man takpi kong cih inah amaute in a thaman uh a ngah khin uh hi.

Ahih hangin note in thu na nget uh ciangin inndei sungah lut unla, kong na khak khit uh ciangin a simthamin a om na Pa kiangah thu ngen un. A simthamte a mu na Pa un kilang takin thaman hong pia ding hi.
Thu na nget uh ciangin lawkite bangin na gen sasa uh gen phapha kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in tampi tak a gen ciang bekin a dawng dingin ngaihsun uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute bangin om kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh na Pa un na nget ma-un na kisapnate uh na thei khin hi.
Tua hi a, na thungetzia ding uh hih bang ahi hi: vantunga om kote Pa aw, nangma min a siangtho hi.
Na Kumpigam hong tung tahen. Vantung ah na deihna a kisep mah bangin leitung ah zong hong kisem tahen.

Ze-etna hong thuaksak kei in. Gilopa kiang pan hong honkhia in. Kumpigam, Vangliatna leh Minthanna a tawntung in nang aa ahi hi. HalleluYah!
Banghang hiam cihleh mite khialhnate na maisak uhleh, vantunga note Pa in zong hong maisak ding hi.

An na tan peuhpeuh uh ciangin a vul ningniangin a om, a kineihkhemte bangin om kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh mite tungah amau antan lam a kilat nadingin a maigumsak uh hi. Ken a mantakpi kong cih inah: Amaute in a thaman a ngah khin uh hi.
Ahih hangin note in an na tan uh ciangin, na lu sathau nuh unla na mai phiat un.
Tua hileh na antan lam uh mite tungah kilang lo ding a, ahih hangin a simtham-a om na Pa tungah kilang ding hi. A simthamte a mu na Pa un kilang takin thaman hong pia ding hi.
Na van manphate uh nget in a nek theihna, a kekseu theihna leh gutate lutin a guk theihna leitung ah no aa dingin khol kei un.
Nget in a nek theih lohna, a kekseu theih lohna leh gutate lutin a guk theih lohna mun vantung ah na van manphate uh no aa dingin kholzaw un.
Banghang hiam cihleh na van manpha omna ah a lungsim om ding hi.
Mittang pen pumpi aa dingin meivak ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin na mit a hoih leh, na pumpi bup khuavak tawh kidim ding hi.
Ahih zongin na mit a siat leh, na pumpi bup mialcip ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin na sunga om khuavak pen khuamial hileh, tua khuamial bangzah takin mial ding ahi hiam?

Kuamah in to nih’ na semkhawm zo lo hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amah in khat mudah-in, khat it ding hi. Ahih keileh khat tungah citakin, a khat tungah simmawh ding hi. Note pen Yahweh sila leh hauhna sila na hi khawm thei kei ding uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin ken kong cih inah: bang ne a, bang dawn ding ci-in na nuntak nading uh lunghimawh kei un. Bang silh bang teeng ding ka hi hiam ci-in na pumpi aa dingin zong lunghimawh kei in. An sangin nuntakna thupizaw a, puansilh nikteen sangin pumpi thupizaw hilo ahi hiam?

Huih laka vasate en un. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in an vawh lo, an la lo, ansaal ah zong an khol lo uh hi. Tua hinapi-in vantunga note Pa in amaute vak hi. Vasate sangin nakpi takin manphazaw hilo na hi uh hiam?
Note lakah kua in na lunghihmawhna uh tawh na tun uh tong khat behlap thei na hi uh hiam?
Tua hi a, bang hangin silh leh ten ding tawh lunghimawh ding na hi uh hiam? Gamlaka unok pakte khankhiat zia ngaihsun dih un. Amaute in gimpi-in nasem loin khau zong khek lo hi.
Tua hi napi, Solomon zong ama thupitna khempeuh tawh a kizep nangawn hihte khat bangin etlawm lo lai hi.
No upna neu mite aw, tuni-a nungta-in zingciangin meikhuk sunga kikhul lel ding hih gamlak lopate Yahweh in puansilh guan ahih leh, note puansilh hong guanzaw mahmah ding hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin lunghimawhna tawh, “Bang ne-in, bang dawnin, bang silh ding ka hi hiam?” ci kei in.
Banghang hiam cihleh Gentile mite in hih nate khempeuh a lunghimawhpih uh hi. Tua hi a, vantunga note Pa in tuate na kisap lam uh hong thei hi.
Ahi zongin Yahweh Kumpigam leh Ama hoihna zong masa un. Tua ciangin hih nate khempeuh hong kipiak beh ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingcianga dingin lunghimawh khol kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh zingciang vai ding amah le amah na lunghimawh ding hi. Tuni-a lungkhamna pen tuni-a dingin phazo hi.
Nang zong hong kimawhsak loh nadingin mi mawhsakte lakah om kei in.
Banghang hiam cihleh mi dangte tung thu na khen bangun no tungah thu hong kikhen ding hi. Tua hi a, mi tunga na zat uh tehna mah tawh note hong kiteh ding hi.
Tu-in na mit sunga singluang phawk loin, bang hangin na sanggampa’ mit sunga ninthem etsak ding na hi hiam?
En dih in, na mit sunga singluang khat om napi, bang hangin na sanggampa kiangah, “Na mit sunga ninthem hong lak khiatsak ning,” ci thei ding na hi hiam?
No a kineihkhem te aw! Note mit sunga singluang lakhia masa un. Tua ciangin na sanggampa’ mit sunga ninthem na lakhiatsak theih nadingun hoih takin na mu thei pan ding uh hi.
A siangtho nate ui pia kei unla, vokpi maiah na suang manphate uh lot kei un. Tua bang hi keileh a khe nuai-ah tuancil ding uh a, tua ciangin kihei-in hong pet lai ding uh hi.
Ngen un, hong kipia ding hi. Zong un, na mu ding uh hi. Kiu un, hong kihon ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh a ngen mi peuhmah in ngah ding a, a zong mipa in mu-in a kiu mipa kihon ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh na tate un anlum hong ngen leh suangtum a pia ding kua om na hi uh hiam?
Ahih keileh ngasa hong ngen leh, gul pia ding na hi uh hiam?
Tua hi a, no mawhnei mi in na tate tungah na hoih piakzia ding thei na hih uh leh, vantunga om note Pa in ama kianga a ngente tungah na hoih piak ding bang zahtakin theizaw lai ding ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin no tunga hong kibawl ding na deih khempeuh uh mi dangte tungah na bawl un. Banghang hiam cihleh hih in Thukham leh kamsangte hong hilh thu ahi hi.
Kong kawcik ah lut un. Banghang hiam cihleh siatna a tun lampi zai a, kongpi tanzau-in, mi tampi in tua lampi zui uh hi.
Nuntakna mun tun nading kongkhak kawcik a, lampi neu ahih manin mi tawmno cik bek in zui hi.
A sunglam uh ngia hi napi tuumul silhin hong pai kamsang zuaute kiang pan na kikem un.
Amaute a gahin na thei ding uh hi. Lingkung panin leenggah kilo ngei a, thangling kung panin theigah kilo ngei ahi hiam?
Tua mah bangin singkung hoih panin gah hoih gah a, ahih hangin singkung hoih lo panin gah hoih lo gah hi.
Singkung hoih panin gah hoih lo gah thei lo a, singkung hoih lo panin gah hoih gah thei lo hi.
Gah hoih a gah lo singkung khempeuh kiphukin mei sungah kikhul hi.
Tua hi a, amaute a gahin na thei ding uh hi.
Kei kiangah, “Sia aw! Sia aw!” hong ci khempeuh Yahweh Kumpigam sungah lut kim lo ding a, ahih hangin vantunga om ka Pa deihna bangin a gamtate bek lut thei ding uh hi.

Tua ni ciangin mi tampi in kei kiangah, “Sia aw! Sia aw! Kote in nangma min tawh kamsangin, nangma min tawh dawite hawlkhia-in, nangma min tawh na lamdang tampi bawl hilo ka hi uh hiam?” hong ci ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute kiangah, “Note kong thei ngei kei hi. Kei kiang panin paikhia un, no mawhna bawlbawl te aw!” ka ci ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih ka thugennate za-in a zui mi peuhmah suang tunga inn a lam mipilpa tawh kibang hi.
Guah zu-in, tui hong khang a, huihpi nungin, tua inn a nawk hangin suang tunga inn kilam ahih manin a puk kei hi.
Ahih hangin hih ka thugennate za napi-in a zui lo mi peuhmah sehnel tunga inn a lam mihaipa tawh kibang hi.
Guah zu-in, tui hong khang a, huihpi nungin a nawk ciangin kipuk a, tua pukna lian mahmah hi, a ci hi.
Yahshua in hih thute a gen khit ciangin mi honpite in ama thuhilhna lamdangsa uh hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh amah in lai-atte bangin thuhilh loin thunei khat bangin hilh hi.
Yahshua mual tung panin a paisuk ciangin mihon tampi in zui hi.
En in, miphak khat pai-in amah bia a, “Sia aw, nong damsak nop leh, nong damsak thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in a khut zankhia-in amah lawng a, “Kong damsak nuam hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a phak natna panin a dampah hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Hih thu kuamah na gen loh nadingin kikem in. Siampipa kiangah pai inla kilak in. Amaute tungah na damna teci dingin Mosheh tungtawn a kipia ngeina bangin biakpiakna va pia in,” a ci hi.
Capernaum khua ah Yahshua a lut ciangin ama kiangah Rom galkap zakhat a uk galkapbu khat pai-in thuum a,
“Sia aw, ka nasempa pumzaw-in ka inn ah lum a, nakpi-in a na thuak hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Pai-in ka damsak ding hi,” ci hi.
Galkap bupa in, “Sia aw, ka bikha nuai-ah nong pai liang nadingin bangmah ka hi kei hi. Tua hi a, thu pia lecin ka nasempa dam ding hi.

Banghang hiam cihleh kei zong thuneite khutnuai-a om khat ka hi hi. Ka khutnuai ah zong galkapte om a, hih mipa kiangah, ‘Pai in’ cileng, amah pai a, a dang khat kiangah, ‘Hong pai in,’ cileng, amah hong pai hi. Tua hi a, ka nasempa kiangah ‘Hih sem in,’ cileng sem hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in hih thu a zak ciangin lamdangsa a, amah a zui mite kiangah, “Ken a mantakpi kong cih inah: Hih bang upna lian ka mu ngei nai kei hi. Israyl sungah zong ka mu kei hi,” a ci hi.
Note tungah kong gen nop lai-ah, “Nisuahna lam leh nitumna lam panin mi tampi hong pai ding a, Yahweh Kumpigam ah Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tawh tukhawm ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin kumpigam’ tate pen pualam khuamial sungah a kipia ding hi. Tua laiah kahna leh ha gawina om ding hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in galkap bupa kiangah, “Na pai nading ah pai in. Na upna bangin nang aa dingin piang tahen,” a ci hi. Tua hun mahin a nasempa a dam hi.
Kepha’ inn sungah Yahshua a tun ciangin lupna tungah cina-in a lum Kepha’ sunghnu a mu hi.
Yahshua in a khut lawng a, tuanu a dam hi. Tua ciangin amah tho a, amaute zindo hi.
Nitak a tun ciangin Yahshua kiangah dawilut tampi kipaipih hi. Amah in kam khat pauna bek tawh khate hawlkhia a, cina khempeuh a dam uh hi.
Hih in, “Ei mawhnate hangin amah kisatnim a, ama kisatna hangin eite i dam hi,” ci-in kamsang Isayah tungtawnin a kigen thu a tangtung ahi hi.
Tu-in Yahshua in a kimkota mihon tampite a muh ciangin bualtui langkhat ah pai dingin a nungzuite thupia hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah lai-at khat pai a, “Sia aw, na paina peuhpeuh ah kong zui ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in, “Ngiate in kua nei a, huih lak vasate in buk nei uh hi. Ahih hangin Mihing Tapa in a lutang a ngak nading mun nei lo hi,” a ci hi.
A nung a zui mi dangkhat in, “Sia aw, kei va pai-in, ka pa hong vui masa sak in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Hong zui in, misi pen misite mah in na vui uh hen,” a ci hi.
Gunkuang tungah Yahshua a tuan ciangin a nungzuite in zui uh hi.
Tua ciangin thakhatin tuipi tungah huihpi khauh takin nung a, tuihual hangin a gunkuang uh a tum dektak hi. Ahih hangin Yahshua ihmu hi.
A nungzuite ama kiangah pai-in phong uh a, “Sia aw, hong hon in! Tuikia-in si ding ka hita uh hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Upna neute aw, bang hangin lau na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah tho-in huihpi leh tuipi taii-in, a daipah deda hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite in lamdangsa uh a, “Hihpa a bangci mi ahi hiam? Huihpi leh tuipi nangawn in a thu mang hi,” a ci uh hi.

Gadarene mite teenna gam galkhat tuipi nawl a tun ciangin kuamah in amau omna gei tua lampi a tot ngam loh zah dong dingin a gilo ngongtat dawilut mi nih han panin hong paikhia-in Yahshua a dawntuah uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiko uh a, “Yahweh Tapa, Yahshua aw, kote bang hong cih nuam na hi hiam? A hun tungnailopi-in kote gim pia dingin hong pai na hi hiam?
Tu-in amaute kiang pan a kigamla lua lo khat ah vok honpi khat an ne-in a om hi.
Tua ciangin dawite in Yahshua kiangah thuum uh a, “Kote nong hawlkhiat leh, vok honte sungah ka lut ding uh hong phal in,” a ci uh hi.
Yahshua in, “Pai un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute paikhia-in vok honte sungah a lut uh hi. En in, tua vok hong khempeuh ken lakah taisuk gawpin tuipi sung kidenna uh a, tui kia-in a si uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua vok hon cingte tai-in khuapi sung lut uh a, dawilut mite tunga thupiang khempeuh a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua tawh kimu dingin khuasung mi khempeuh hong pai uh a, Yahshua a muh uh ciangin a gam uh panin a paikhiat nadingin thuum uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahshua zong gunkuangpi sungah tutin, tuipi galkhat ah pai a, Ama khua ah a lut hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in lupna tunga lum, pumzaw khat Yahshua kiangah a paipih uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahshua in amau upna a muh ciangin pumzaw mipa kiangah, “Ka tapa aw, nakpi-in ki hangsansak in, na mawhnate hong kimaisak khin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin en in, lai-atsia pawlkhat in a lungsim uh ah, “Hih mipa pausia hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa in leitung ah mawhna maisak theihna thu a neihna na theih nadingun (tua khit ciangin Amah in pumzaw mipa kiangah): Tho in, na lupna la inla, na inn ah ciah in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah thoto in, a inn ah a ciah hi.

Nitak lamin inn sung sabuai phungah Yahshua a tut laitak in siahdongte leh mawhneite tampi pai uh a, Yahshua leh a nungzuite tawh a tukhawm uh hi.

Ahi zongin Yahshua i tua thu a zak ciangin amaute kiangah, “Didamte aa dingin siavuan kisam lo a, cina mite bek kisam uh hi.

Ahi zongin note pai-in, “Biakpiakna sangin hehpihna ka deihzaw hi,” cih a khiatna va kan phot un. Banghang hiam cihleh mi hoihte a sam dingin hong pai ka hi kei a, mawhneite a kisikkik nadingin a sam dingin hong pai ka hi zaw hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin tuiphumpa Yahchanan’ nungzuite Yahshua kiangah hong pai-in, “Kote leh Pharisee-te in antang zelzel napi-in, bang hangin na nungzuite in antang ngeilo ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Zineipa amau tawh a omkhop laisiah mopawi siimte thumin tau-in om ding ahi hiam? Ahih hangin amaute kiang panin Zi neipa a kilak khiat hun hong tung ding a tua ciangin amaute in an tang ding uh hi.
Kuamah in puanlui phopna-in puan bek thak zong ngei lo hi. Banghang hiam cihleh a phopna puanbek thak in a puan kaigawp ding a, a kekna gol semsem ding hi.

Tua mah bangin kuamah in leenggah umna savun lui sungah leenggah zu thak koih ngei lo hi. Tua bang hi keileh, Savun um puakkham ding hi. Yahshua in amaute tungah hih thute a gen laitakin, en in, makai khat hong pai-in Amah bia a, “Ka tanu tumah-in si hi; ahih hangin hong pai-in ama tungah na khut nga le cin amah nungta ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahshua dingto-in, amah zui-a, a nungzuite in zong a zui hi.
Tua ciangin kum sawm le kum nih sung tawntung siluang natna a vei numei khat in Yahshua nung zui-in a puantual mongtep; tzitzit, a lawng hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua kihei a, Amah in tuanu a muh ciangin, “Ka tanu aw, lungnuam takin om in. Na upna in hong damsak khin hi,” a ci hi. Tua hun lian panin tua numei a dam hi.

Ahih hangin mite a kipaikhiatsak khit ciangin Amah a sungah lutin nungakno a khut a let ciangin nungakno a hong thoto hi.
Tua ciangin hih thu tua gam khempeuh ah a kizel hi.

Yahshua inn sungah a lut ciangin mittaw tenih ama kiangah a pai hi. Tua ciangin Yahshua in, amaute kiangah, “Hih thei dingin hong um na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Sia aw, ka um uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a mitte lawnsakin, “Na up bangun piang tahen,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amau mitte a kihong hi. Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Hih thu kuamah theisak kei un,” ci-in khauh takin a kham hi.
Ahih hangin amaute a paikhiat uh ciangin, tua gam khempeuh ah Yahshua thu a kizelsak uh hi.
Amaute a paikhiat uh ciangin, en un, a pau thei lo dawilut pasal khat ama kiangah hong kipaipih hi.
Dawi a kihawlkhiat khit ciangin a pau thei lo pa a pau thei pah hi Tua ciangin mihonpite in lamdangsa uh a, “Israyl sungah hih bang thu kimu ngei nai lo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pharisee-te in, “Amah in dawi mangpipa tungtawnin dawite a hawlkhia ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin khuapite leh khuaneute khempeuh ah Yahshua pai kawikawi-in, a kikhopna innte sungah thu hilhin, Kumpigam lungdamna thu gen a, mite laka cina khempeuh leh natna khempeuh a damsak hi.
Yahshua in mihonpite a muh ciangin amaute a hehpih mahmah hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute lunggimin, a huh ding nei lo uh a, tuucing om lo tuute tawh a kibang uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a zungzuite kiangah, “An lak ding tampi tak om a, ahih hangin nasemte a tawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama an a la ding nasemte hong sawl nadingin An Neipa tungah thu ngen un,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in a kiangah a nungzui sawm-le-nihte a sap khit ciangin, kha ninte hawl khiat theih nading, damlohna khempeuh leh natna nam khempeuh damsak theih nading vangliatna amaute tungah a pia hi.
Tu-in hihte pen nungzuipi sawm-le-nihte min ahi hi: A masa pen ah Kepha kici Simon leh a sanggampa Andrew, Zabdyah’ tapate ahi Yaaqob leh a sanggampa Yahchannan,
Philip leh Bar-Tolmai, Thomas leh siahdong Mattithyah, Cheleph’ tapa Yaaqob leh thaddaeus kici Lebbaeus,
Canaan mi Simon leh, Yahshua a lehhekpa Yahdah Iscariot ahi uh hi.
Hih sawm-le-nihte Yahshua in sawlkhia-in, thupia a, “Gentile mite lampi ah pai kei unla, Samaria mite khuppite ah zong lut kei un.
Tua sangin Israyl innkuan a mangthang tuute kiangah paizaw un.
Na pai uh ciangin, ‘Yahweh Kumpigam hong nai ta hi,’ ci-in thu va hilh un.
Cinate damsakin, miphakte siangsak unla, misite thosakin, dawite hawlkhia un. A mawkna-a na ngah uh a mawkna mahin na pia un.
Na kawnggak uh ah kham ahi a, ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin keng kei un.
Lampi-a na zat ding uh thung-ip ahi a, puan-ak nih ahi a, khedap ahi a, ciangkhut ahi zongin keng kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh nasempa in ama kisaptawm teng a ngah ding a kilawm hi.
Khua khat peuhpeuh ahih keileh khua sung khat peuhpeuh ah na lut uh ciangin kua kiangah zin tung leng kilawmpen ding hiam cih kan unla, na ciah matengun tua mun ah taamsuak un.
Inn khatpeuh ah na lut uh ciangin hopih masa un.
Tua innkuan in nopna ngah ding a kilawm leh, na shalom uh tua inn ah teng henla, tua bang ahih keileh, tua nopna thupha note kiang hong tungkik hen.
Mi khatpeuh in note hong sang loin, na thugente uh hong ngaih keileh, tua inn ahih keileh tua khuapi panin na paikhiat uh ciangin na khe uh panin leivui singkhia un.
Ken a man takpi kong cih inah: Thukhen ni ciangin tua khuapi thuakna sangin Sodom leh Gomorrah gamte thuakna nopzaw ding hi.
En un, ngiahon lakah tuu bangin note kong sawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin gul bangin pilvang unla, vakhu bangin migi un.
Mite kiang pan kidawm un! Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in gam-ukte kiangah hong apin, a kikhopna innte ah hong sat ding uh hi.
Keima hangin kumpite leh gam-uk mangpite maiah note hong kipuak ding a, tua in amaute leh Gentile mite tungah teci na suah nading uh ahi hi.
Amaute in hong ap uh ciangin bang thu genin, bangci gen ding ka hi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh na thugen ding uh a hun lianin hong kipia ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh a gen ding pen note na hi kei uh a, note tungtawnin na Pa uh Kha in a gen ding ahi hi.
Unau khat leh khat a sih nadingin kilehhek ding a, Pa in a ta lehhek ding hi. Tate in a nu leh a pate langpangin a kithah nadingin a lehhek ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Keima Min hangin mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a tawp dongin a thuakzo mi kihonkhia ding hi.

Ahi zongin hih khuapi ah note hong kibawlsiat leh khua dang ah tai un. Banghang hiam cihleh ken a man takpi kong cih inah: Mihing Tapa hong pai mateng Israyl khuapite thuaksak loin ka koihkhong kei ding hi.
Nungzui khat pen a siapa sangin lianzaw lo a, nasem khat zong a ukpa sangin lianzaw lo hi.

Nungzui khat in a siapa a bat zawh leh ama aa dingin phazo a, nasem khat in a ukpa a bat zawh leh phazo hi. Amaute in Inntekpipa, Baalzebul ci ahih uh leh, Ama innkuanpih dangte bangzah takin telkhial zawsem ding uh ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin amaute kihta kei un. Banghang hiam cihleh a kilangkhia lo ding-a kikhuhcip hitaleh a kithei lo ding a kiselcip thei bangmah hong lo hi.
Khuamial sunga kong gente khuavak ah gen unla, na bil uh-a na zak khiankhian thute innkhum tung panin tangko un.
Pumpi a that theih hangin kha a that thei lote na kihta kei un. Tua sangin Gehenna ah kha leh pumpi a nihtuakin a susia theipa na kihta zaw un.
Kawlgit nih mat khatin kizuak hilo ahi hiam? Tua hi napi-in, amaute khat beek zong na Pa uh deihna om loin lei ah a mawk kiat kei hi.
Note na hih uh leh na lu tung uh-a na samzang phazah nangawn kiciamteh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lau kei un. Kawlgit tampi sangin na manphazaw uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keima mi ahihna mite maiah a pulak mi peuhmah, ken zong vantunga om ka Pa maiah keima mi ahihna ka pulak ding hi.
Ahih hangin mite maiah kei hong nial mi peuhmah, keimah in zong vantunga om ka Pa mai panin tua mi ka nial ding hi.
Leitung ah kilemna bawl dinga hong pai hi, ci-in hong ngaihsun kei un. Kilemna bawl dingin hong pai ka hi kei a, namsau khah dinga hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
Tapa leh a pa, tanu leh a nu, tek leh mo a kilangpangsak dingin hong pai ka hi hi.
Mi khat gal in ama innkuanpihte mah ahi ding hi.
Kei sangin a nu a pa a itzaw mi, keima aa dingin kitaan lo hi.
Ama hakkol pua loin keimah hong zui mi, keima aa dingin kitaan lo hi.
A nuntakna a hu nuam mi in nuntakna tanlawh ding a, keima hangin a nuntakna a suplawh mi in nuntakna ngah ding hi.
Note hong sang mi in kei hong sang hi a, kei hong sang mi in kei hong Sawlpa a sang ahi hi.
Kamsangpa’ thuneihna hangin kamsangpa a sang mi in kamsangte’ thaman ngah ding a, mi hoihpa’ gamtat luhekzia hangin mi hoih khat a sang mi in mi hoihte’ thaman ngah ding hi.
Ken a man takpi kong cih inah nungzui khat thuneihna tungtawn bekin hih naupangnote khatpeuh tungah nuntakna leenggahzu-hai a pia mi peuhmah in a thaman taan lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in a zungzui sawm-le-nihte thu a piak khit ciangin khuapite ah thugen ding leh thuhilh dingin tua lai panin amah a paikhia hi.
Tu-in tuiphumpa Yahchanan in thong sung panin Messiah nasepnate a zak ciangin a nungzui tenih sawl a,
amaute in, “Hong pai dingpa na hi hiam, ahih keileh adang na ngak lai ding ka hi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Yahshua in dawngin, amaute kiangah, “Ciahkik unla, na muhsa uh leh na zaksa thute uh Yahchanan kiangah va gen un.
Mittawte in khua mu-in khebaite lampai uh a, miphakte siangin, bengngongte in khua za uh hi. Misite kithokiksak a, mizawngte tungah kumpigam thu kihilh hi.
Ka nial loh mipa thupha ngah ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Amaute a paikhiat uh ciangin Yahshua in Yahchanan tawh kisai-in mihonte kiangah thu gen kipan a, “Bang en dingin gamlak ah pai na hi uh hiam? Huih in a mut diamdiam pungpeng kungte en dinga pai na hi uh hiam?
Ahihkeileh bang en dinga pai na hi uh hiam? Puan hoih nono a silh mi khatpeuh en dinga pai na hi uh hiam? En un, puan hoih nono a silh mite pen kumpi-innte ah om uh hi.
Tua ahih leh bang en dinga pai na hi uh hiam? Kamsang khat en ding pai na hi uh hiam? Hi hi, ken kong cih inah, amah pen kamsang khat hiziau loin tua sang a lianzaw hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh Lai Siangtho in a gelhna ah, ‘En un, Keimah in ka vantungmi ka sawl ding a, amh in na pai nading lampi a sialkhol ding hi,’ a cihpa in Yahchanan ahi hi.

Ken a man takpi kong cih inah numei sung panin a suak mite lakah tuiphumpa Yahchanan sangin a lianzaw a om nai kei hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh Kumpigam sunga a neupen khat zong amah sangin a lianzaw lai hi.
Tuiphumpa Yahchanan huna kipan tu ciangin Yahweh Kumpigam in zawhthawhna thuak a, mite in thatang suangin a la uh hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh kamsangte khempeuh leh Thukham in Yahchanan hun dong a piang ding thute genkhol uh hi.
Tua a kigensa thute na sannop uh ahih leh, hong pai ding Yliyah in Yahchanan ahi hi.
Zak nading bil a neite in za ta un.
Ahi zongin tu khang mite bang tawh genteh ding ka hi hiam? Vanzuakna phualpite ah a tu naupangnote in a lawmte samin amaute kiangah,
‘Note aa dingin tamngai ka tum uh hangin na lam kei uh a, ka kahkah uh hangin lah na tamlo tuan kei uh hi,’ a cih tawh kibang hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh an ne lo, tui dawn loin Yahchanan hong pai a, ahih hangin amaute in, ‘Dawi vei hi,’ a ci uh hi.
An ne, tui dawnin Mihing Tapa hong pai a, amaute in, ‘En un, an hai, zu haipa! Siahdongte leh mawhneite zawlpa,’ a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin pilna ahih leh a gah in kilangkhiasak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahsua in na lamdang tampi a bawlna khuapite a mawhna uh kisikkik lo uh ahih manin a taai hi.

Amah in, “Chorazin khua aw, gimna na thuak ding hi! Bethsaida aw, gimna na thuak ding hi! Banghang hiam cihleh note tunga hong kibawl na lamdangte Tyre khuapi leh Sidon khuapi ah kibawl leh, sawt pekin puanhampi leh vut tawh kisikkik khin ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ken kong cih inah, thukhen ni ciangin note thuakna sangin Tyre leh Sidon khuate thuakna thuaknopzaw ding hi!
Van banin a kiliansak Capernaum aw, Sheol ah hong kipuaksuk ding hi. Banghang hiam cihleh nang sunga hong kibawl na lamdangte Sodom ah kibawl leh, tuni dong tua khuapi kip lai ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ken kong cih inah, thukhen ni ciangin nangma thuakna sangin Sodom khuapi thuakna thuaknopzaw ding hi!” a ci hi.

Tua hunin Yahshua in thugenin, “Vantung leh leitung a Piangsak, Pa aw, nang tungah ka lungdam hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Nangmah in mipil, miciimte kiang pan hih thute seelcipin, naungekte tungah tuate na laakkhia hi.
Pa aw, tua mah bangin piang tahen. Banghang hiam cihleh hih in Na muhna ah ngimna hoih ahi hi.

Ka Pa in na khempeuh kei tungah hong pia khin hi. Tua hi a, Pa simloh kicing takin Tapa a thei kuamah om lo a, tua mah bangin Tapa leh Tapa in Yahweh’ deihna bangin a theihsak mite simloh kuamah in kicing takin Pa a thei kei hi.
Vangik pua-in a gim mi khempeuh aw, ka kiangah hong pai un, tawldamna kong pia ding hi.
Ka hakkol kisuan unla, kei kiangah hong kisin dih un. Ka lungnemin, kiniamkhiat ka hih manin lungsim tawldamna na ngah ding uh hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh ka hakkol nuamin, ka van a zang hi,” a ci hi.
Tua hun sung Shabbat ni khatin lo sung nawkin Yahshua pai a, a nungzuite gil kial uh ahih manin buhvuite zut-in a ne uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pharisee-te in a muh uh ciangin Yahshua kiangah, “En in, na nungzuite in Shabbat ni-a sep dingin thukham tawh kituak loin gamta uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “David leh a pawlte in a gil kial lai-un a sep thu simkha ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Amah leh a lawmte Yahweh Inn sungah lutin, amaute nek dingin thukham tawh a kituak lo, siampite bek in a nek uh ompihna anlum ne uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua banah Shabbat Ni-in siampite in Yahweh Inn sungah Shabbat ninsak napi-in a kimawhsak loh lam Thukham sungah sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Ahi zongin ken kong cih inah, hih biakinn sangin a lianzaw Yahweh Inn khat hih laiah om hi.
Note in, ‘Biakpiakna sangin hehpihna ka deihzaw hi,’ ci-in a kigelh thu a khiatna thei le uh cin, a khial lopite na mawhsak kei ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mihing Tapa pen Shabbat thu ah sia khat zong ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai panin Yahshua paisuakin amaute kikhona inn sungah a lut hi.

Tua hi a, en un, tua laiah a khut langkhat a zaw mi khat om hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Yahshua a mawhmat theih nadingun ama kiangah thu dong uh a, “Shabbat Nite ah cina damsak ding thukham tawh a kituak hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute dong a, “Note in tuu khat nei-in na tuu uh Shabbat Ni-in dum sung khat ah kia leh, na khut uh tawh zamin a kaito lo ding note lakah kua om na hi uh hiam?
Tuu khat sangin mihing khat bangzah takin manphazaw ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin Shabbat Ni-in a pha bawl ding thukham tawh kituak hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahshua in mipa kiangah, “Na khut zan khia in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a khut zan khia a, a khut langkhat mah bangin hoihin a dampah hi.
Tua ciangin Pharisee-te pai khia-in Yahshua bangci thah theih ding cih thu kikupna a nei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in tua thu a theih ciangin tua lai panin a paikhia hi. Mihon tampi in amah zui uh a, amah in amaute khempeuh a damsak hi.
Ahih hangin amah in ama thu a genkhiat loh nadingun a kham hi.
Tua in kamsang Isayah tungtawnin a kigensa thu a tangtun nading ahi hi. A genna ah:
“En un! Ka teelsa ka Nasempa! Ka Teelkhiatpa sungah ka lungkim mahmah hi! Ama tungah Keima Kha ka koih khin a, amah in Gentile mite tungah thumaan thutak pulak ding hi.
Amah in thu seel loin, a aw zong sangkhai lo ding a, kong zing lakah a aw a kizasak kei ding hi.
Amah in man takin thumaan thutak a pulak khit mateng a kitamsa pumpeng kuaitan lo ding a, a tanglai meivak a sumit kei ding hi.
Gentile mite in Ama Min muang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin mittaw-in a pau thei lo dawilut khat Yahshua kiangah kipaipih a, Yahshua in amah damsak ahih manin a pau thei lo mittawpa pau thei-in khua a mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, “Hihpa David’ Tapa hilo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tu-in Pharisee-te in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, “Hihpa in dawite mangpipa Baalzebul tungtawnin dawite a hawlkhia ahi lel hi!” a ci uh hi.

Tu-in Yahshua in amau ngaihsutnate thei ahih manin amaute kiangah, “Kumpigam khat peuhpeuh amah leh amah a kilangkhen leh tua gam kisia a, khuapi khatpeuh ahih keileh innkuan khat peuhpeuh amau leh amau a kilangkhen leh kip lo ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Satan in Satan hawlkhia leh, amah leh amah kikhenkham ahi hi. Tua bang ahih ciangin ama kumpigam bangci kip thei ding ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, keimah in Baalzebul suangin dawite hawlkhia ka hih leh, na mipihte un kua tungtawnin dawite hawlkhia uh ahi hiam? Tua bang ahih mawk leh, amaute na thukhen uh hi tahen.
Ahih hangin keimah in Yahweh’ Kha tawh dawite a hawlkhia ka hih leh, note tungah Yahweh Kumpigam hong tung khin hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh mi khat in a thahat mi khat hencip masa phot loin bangci bangin mi thahatpa’ inn sung lutin, a neihsa sut thei ding ahi hiam? A hencip khit ciangin a inn a luh thei pan ding hi.
Kei tawh a kipawl lo mi in kei hong langpan hi a, kei tawh mite hong kaihkhoppih lo mi in a thehthang ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ken kong cih inah, mihingte tunga mawhna peuhmah leh pausiatna peuhmah kimaisak ding a, ahih hangin Kha tunga pausiatna a kimaisak kei ding hi.
Mihing Tapa a gensia peuhmah kimaisak ding a, ahih hangin Kha Siangtho a gensia peuhmah tu khang hitaleh hong pai lai ding khang ah zong a kimaisak kei ding hi.
Singkung hoih in gah hoih gahsak a, singkung hoih lo in gah hoih lo gahsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin singkung a gahin kithei hi.
Gul gupha’ suante aw! Note mi hoih lo kimlai bangci bangin thu hoih gen thei ding na hi uh hiam? Banghang hiam cihleh lungsim panin a dimlet thute kam in genkhia takpi hi.
Mi hoih khat in a lungsim sunga a khol thu hoihte genkhia a, misia khat in a kholsa thusia teng genkhia hi.
Ken kong cih inah, mite thugen nasepna a gensia mi peuhmah in thukhen ni ciangin tua thu ah sittelna a thuak ding uh hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh na kampauna uh tawh kizui-in dik hong kitangsak ding a, na kampauna mah uh tawh kizui-in hong kimawhsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin lai-atte leh Pharisee-te pawlkhat in dawngin, Yahshua kiangah, “Nang kiang panin lim khat ka mu nuam uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “A gilo, a paktat khang mite in lim hong ngen tazen uh hi. Kamsang Yahnah lim simloh lim khat zong hong kipia lo ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh ngapi gil sungah Yahnah sun thum leh zan thum a om mah bangin, Mihing Tapa zong lei sungah sun thum leh zan thum a om ding hi.

Thukhen ni ciangin Nineveh khua mite hong ding to-in, hih khang mite a mawhsak ding uh hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Yahnah’ thuhilhna hangin amaute a mawhna uh kisikkik uh hi. Tua hi a, en un, Yahnah sangin a lianzaw Khat hih laiah om hi.

Thukhen ni ciangin leitaw lam kumpinu; Sheba kumpinu, ding to-in, hih khang mite mawhsak ding hi. Banghang hiam cihleh Solomon (Shelomo) pilna a ngai dingin lei mong tawng pek panin amah a pai hi. Tua hi a, en un, Solomon sangin a lianzaw Khat hih laiah a om hi.
Mi khat sung panin kha nin a paikhiat ciangin tua kha nin munkeuna tengah pai kawikawi a, tawlngak nading mun a zon hangin a mu kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in, ‘Ka paikhiatna inn ah ka pai kik ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tua hi a, amah a tun ciangin tua inn na awngin, na kiphiat siang a, hoih takin a omna a mu hi.

Tua ciangin amah pai-in, amah sangin a siazaw adang kha sagih a paipih hi. Amaute lutin, tua laiah a teng uh hi. Tua hi a, tua mipa dinmun pen a masa sangin a nunung a siazaw hi. A gilo tu lai khang mite zong tua mah tawh kibang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Mipite tungah Yahshua in thu a gen laitakin en in, a nu leh a sanggamte in amah hopih nuamin a pualam ah a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khat in , “En in, na nu leh na sanggamte in hong hopih nuamin, a pualam ah ding uh hi,” ci-in a va gen hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in tua thu a va gen mipa kiangah, “Ka nu kua hi a, ka sanggamte kua ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in a nungzuite lamah a khut zankhia-in, “En un, amaute pen ka nu leh ka sanggamte ahi uh hi!
Banghang hiam cihleh vantung-a om ka Pa deihna bangin a gamta mi peuhmah ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ni mahin inn panin Yahshua paikhia-in tuipi geiah a tu hi.
Ahih hangin ama kiimkot ah mihon tampitak hong kikhol ahih manin gunkuang tungah tuangin tu a, mihon buppi tuipi-nawl ah a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute tungah thu gentehna tawh thu tampi gen a, “En un, khaici vawhpa khaici vawh dingin a pai khia hi.
Amah in khaici a vawh laitakin khaici pawlkhat lamdung ah a kia hi. Tua ciangin vasate hong pai-in, a netum uh hi.
Pawlkhatte suang kitawphah lei daina mun ah kia a, lei dai ahih manin a po pah hi.
Ahih hangin ni hong sat ciangin nitang in kang a, zung kha zo lo ahih manin a vulmang hi.
Pawlkhatte ling lakah kia a, lingkungte hong khangin a depgawp hi.
Ahih hangin khaici pawlkhat pen lei hoihna ah kia a, pawlkhat a zah zakhat, pawlkhat a zah sawmguk, pawlkhat a zah sawmthum a gah hi.
Zak nading bil a nei peuh in za ta un!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua kiangah nungzuite hong pai-in, “Bang hangin amaute tungah thugentehna tawh thu gen na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh Kumpigam thusim lianpi theihtheihna note tungah hong kipia khin a, ahih hangin amaute tungah kipia lo hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh a neisate tungah kipiak beh ding a, tampi tak a nei ding hi. Ahih hangin a nei lo mite kiang panin a neihsun nangawn kilakkhiatsak ding hi.
Tua thu hangin amaute tungah thugentehna tawh a gen ka hi hi. Banghang hiam cihleh amaute in enen napi-in mu thei lo uh a, ngaingai napi-in za loin, zong a telthei kei uh hi.
Isayah in, ‘Tatsat loin na za ding uh a, ahih hangin na telthei kei ding uh hi. Tatsat loin na mu ding uh a, ahih hangin na phawk thei kei ding uh hi.

Hih mite lungsim mawlsak inla, amau bilte bingsakin, a mitte uh humsak in. Tua bang hi keileh amaute in a mit uh tawh mu-in, a bil uh tawh za ding uh a, a lungsim uh tawh telin amaute kikhelin a kidamsak ding hi,’ ci-in a genkholh thu amaute tungah a tangtng ahi hi.
Ahih hangin note na hih uhleh na mit uh tawh mu-in na bil uh tawh za na hih manun a hampha mahmah na hi uh hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh ken a man takpi kong cih inah, kamsang tampi leh mi hoih tampi in na muhte uh mu nuam mahmah-in mu kha lo uh a, na zakte uh za nuam napi-in za kha lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khaici vawhpa tawh thugentehna na ngai un.
Mi khatpeuh in Kumpigam thu a zak ciangin tel thei lo a, gilopa hong pai-in a lungsim sunga kivawh khaici a lakkhiatsak hi. Hih in lamdunga khaici a ngahpa ahi hi.
Suang laka kivawh khaici ahih leh, thu za-in lungdam takin a sang pah mi ahi hi.
Ahih hangin ama sungah zung kha lo ahih manin amah in tomno sung bek a thuakzo hi. Banghang hiam cihleh tua thu hangin haksat gentheihna leh bawlsiatna a om ciangin a lungkia pah hi.
Tu-in ling laka kia khaici pen thu za napi-in, hih leitung lunghihmawh-in a nei, khemna tawh kidim hauhnate in a depgawp a gahzo lo mipa ahi hi.
Ahih hangin lei hoihna-a kivawh khaici pen thu za-in, a theitel, amah gahin, pawlkhat a zah zakhat, a zah sawmguk, a zah sawmthum-in a gahsuah mipa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in amaute kiangah thugentehna dang khat gen a, “Yahweh Kumpigam pen a lo sungah khaici hoih a vawh mipa tawh kibang hi.
Ahih hangin mite a ihmut laitakin a galpa hong pai-in taang lakah tahum a vawh khit ciangin a pai khia hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua pai-in amaute lawng a, “Tho un, lau kei un,” a ci hi.
Amaute a khuadak toh uh ciangin Yahshua simloh a dang kuamah a mu kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin mual tung panin amaute a paisuk kawmin Yahshua in, “Sihna panin Mihing Tapa a kithawh kiksak matengin hih mangmuhna kuama tungah gen kei un,” ci-in a kham hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite in ama kiangah, “Tua hileh bang hangin lai-atte in Yliyah hong pai masa ding hi, ci ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Yahshua in dawngin amaute kiangah, “Yliyah hong pai takpi ding a, na khempeuh a ngei a bangsak kik ding hi.
Ahih hangin ken kong cih inah: Yliyah hong pai khin ta a, amaute in thei lo uh a, ama tungah a ut bangbangun a bawl uh hi. Tua mah bangin Mihing Tapa in amau khutlum a thuak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Tuiphumpa Yahchanan’ thu a gen ahih lam nungzuite in a thei uh hi.
Mihonte kiangah a tun uh ciangin Yahshua kiang tua mun ah mi khat pai-in, a maiah khukdin a,
“Ukpa aw, ka tapa hong hehpih in. Amah pen sibup pahpah-in, nakpi takin a na a thuak hi! Banghang hiam cihleh amah mei khuk sung khawng, tui sung khawng ah tuk pahpah zel hi.
Na nungzuite kiangah ka paipih hangin amaute in a damsak zo kei uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Upna nei lo, a lehtat khang mite aw, bang tanvei hong ompih lai ding ka hi hiam? Bang tanvei note tungah hong lungduai lai ding ka hi hiam? Hih laiah hong paipih in,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in tua dawi a taii hi. Tua ciangin naupang sung pan dawi paikhia a, tua hun lian mahin naupang a na dampah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahshua kiangah nungzuite hong tuam pai uh a, “Bang hangin kote in tua dawi hawlkhia zo lo ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hii.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Note uploh man uh ahi hi. Ken a man takpi kong cih inah: ankam tang cia upna nei-in, hih mualpi kiangah, ‘Hih lai panin hua laiah kikhin in,’ ci le uh cin, kikhin ding a, note aa dingin a piang thei lo bangmah a om kei ding hi.
Ahi ta zongin hih dan dawi namte pen thungetna leh antanna lo tawh taikhia lo uh hi,” a ci hi.
Galilee ah amaute a tun khit uh ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Mihing Tapa kilehhekin mite khut sungah kipia ding hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in that ding uh a, ni thum ciangin amah kithokiksak ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute a dah mahmah uh hi.
Capernaum a tun uh ciangin mi khat ai shekel lang a kaikhawm siahdongte Khepha kiangah hong pai-in, “Na Siapa in biakinn siah pia lo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.

Amah in, “He” a ci hi. Kepha inn sung a lut ciangin Yahshua in Kepha gen ma-in na hopih a, “Simon aw, na bangci ngaihsut hiam? Leitung kumpite in kua kiang pan siah kai uh ahi hiam? A tate kiang pan ahi hiam, ahih keileh mi dangte kiang pan ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Kepha in, “Mi dangte kiang pan,” ci-in a dawng hi. Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Tua ahih ciangin a tate peng hi.

Ahih hangin amaute i lungnopmawhsak loh nadingin tuipi ah va pai-in, ngakawi va siah inla, a awk masapen la in. A kam sung en lecin shekel khat na mu ding hi. Tua la inla, keileh nang aa dingin amaute pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua hunin Yahshua kiangah nungzuite hong pai-in, “Yahweh Kumpiigam ah kua lianpen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in naupangno khat a kiangah samin, amaute lakah a tusak hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih naupangno bangin a kiniamkhiat mi peuhmah Yahweh Kumpigam ah a lianpen ahi hi.
Keima Min twah hih bang naupangno khat a sang mi peuhmah in kei hong sang ahi hi.
Ahih hangin kei hong um hih naupangnote khatpeuh a khialsak mi peuhmah in angawina suanng lianpi khat a ngawng ah khih-in tuipi thuk sungah kikhia leh ama aa dingin hoihzaw ding hi.
A khialsak ding ze-etnate hangin leitung in gim thuak tahen! Ze-etna hong pai ding a kisam hi a, ahih hangin ze-etna hong paikhiatna mi in gimna thuak tahen.

Tua ahih ciangin na khut ahih keileh na khe in hong khialhsak leh, sat khia inla, na kiang panin paai in. Hun tawp ni ciangin meikuang sungah khut kim khe kimin hong kikhul sangin khe tawng khut tawngin nuntakna sungah na lut ding hoihzaw hi.
Na mittang in hong khialhsak leh, khelkhia inla, na kiang panin gamlapi ah paai in. Mit kimin Gehenna ah hong kikhul sangin mit khat bek tawh nuntakna ah na lut ding hoihzaw hi.
Hih naupangnote khatpeuh na simmawh khak loh nadingun kidawm un. Banghang hiam cihleh ken kong cih inah, amau a kem vantungmite in vantunga om Ka Pa maitang vantung ah mu den uh hi.
Mihing Tapa pen mi mangthangte honkhia dinga hong pai ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam? Mi khat in tuu zakhat nei-in, tuate khat lampial leh, sawmkua le kuate nusia-in, mual tung tengah a lampial tuu khat zongin pai ding hilo ahi hiam?
Amah in mu leh, a man takpi kong gen inah a lampial ngei lo sawmkua le kua-te tungah a nuamna sangin tua khat tungah nuamzaw ding hi.

Tua banah, note laka na sanggam khatpeuh mawhna a bawl leh, nang leh amah a kituam muhin a khialhna hilhin. Amah in na thu hong man leh, na sanggampa a ngah na hi hi.
Ahih hangin amah in na thu hong man keileh, teci nih leh thum genna tawh thu khempeuh kikipsak ahih manin nih leh thum tawh va pai in.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute thu a nial lai leh, pawlpi tungah gen un. Ahih hangin amah in *pawlpi thu a man nop tuan keileh, note khempeuh in lawkite leh siahdongte bangin ngaihsun lel un.

Ken a man takpi kong cih inah: leitung ah thukham tawh kituak lo hi, ci-in na tangko peuhmah uh vantung ah zong thukham tawh kituak lo hi, ci-in a kitang ko hi a, leitung ah Thuakham tawh kituak hi, ci-in na tangko peuhmah uh zong vantung ah Thukham tawh kituak hi, ci-in kitangko ding hi. (Mt 16:19)
Tua banah, ken kong cih inah: leitung ah note lak pan mi nih kithutuakin thu na nget uh leh, vantunga om Ka Pa in pia ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh Keima Min tawh mi nih leh thum a omkhopna mun ah Keimah zong amaute laizangah ka om hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah Kepha pai-in, “Sia aw, ka sanggampa kei tungah hong khialh ciangin bangzah vei maisak ding ka hi hiam? Sagihvei dong maisak ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Ken kong cih in ah: sagihvei hito loin sawm sagih mun sagihvei na maisak ding hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh Kumpigam pen a nasemte tawh a sum sayin a sittel nuam kumpipa tawh a kibang hi.
Amah kipanin sum sayin a sit ciangin ama kiangah talent tul sawm* sum a ba mi khat a kipaipih hi. (*Kum 15 ai nasepna thaman zah ahi hi.)
Ahih hangin amah in a leiba pia zo lo ahih manin a pu in amah leh a zi a tate leh a neih khempeuh zuakin, a leibat a loh nadingin thu a pia hi.
Tua taktak ciangin ama maiah nasempa bokin, “Pu aw, hong ngak lai hoh in, a vekpi-in kong loh ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a Pu in tua nasempa hehpih ahih manin a leiba teng maisakin, a khah hi.

Ahih hangin tua nasempa a paikhiat ciangin ama tungah denarius zakhat* sum a ba a naseppih khat a mu hi. Amah in a gawl pan manin “Nong leibat hong pia in!” a ci hi. (*denarius khat pen ni khat ai nasep thaan ahi hi)
Tua ciangin a naseppih a lawmpa a khephung ah bokin, limtakin thumin, “Hong ngak lai hoh in, a vekpi-in kong loh ding hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah ut loin a lawmpa in a leibat a loh khit mateng thong sungah a khum hi.
A naseppi dangte in thu piang teng a muh uh ciangin amaute nakpi-in lungnuam lo uh a, pai-in a Pu kiangah thupiang khempeuh a gen uh hi.
A pu in a sapsak khit ciangin ama kiangah, “Nang, nasem gina lopa! Hong thum na hih manin na leibat khempeuh kong maisak hi.
Nang kong hehpih bangin na naseppih na lawm pa na hehpih ding kilawm hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a pu hehin, a kiba khempeuh a loh khit matengin mi bawlsiate khut sungah a ap hi.
Note khatpeuh in na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh na sanggampa mawhna na maisak kei uh leh Vantung a om ka Pa in zong note tungah tua mah bangin hong bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in hih thute a genkhit ciangin Galilee pan paikhia-in Yardan gun gal Yahdah gam ah a tung hi.
Mihon tampi in Amah zui a, Amah in amaute tua laiah a damsak hi.
Pharisee-te zong Ama kiangah pai-in, “Mi khat in thu khatpeuh hangin a zi a khen ding Thukham tawh a kituak hiam?” ci-in a ze-et uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, “ Amaute a bawlpa in a kipatcil-in numei leh pasal-in amaute bawlin,
‘Tua ahih ciangin mipa in a nu leh a pa nusia-in a zi tawh kipumkhat ding uh a, Thukham tawh kizui-in amaute sakhat hi ding uh hi,’ a cihna thu sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Thukham tawh kisui-in amaute sakhat hilo uh ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in a gawmsa peuhmah kuamah in khen kei tahen,” ci-in dawng hi.
Amaute in Yahshua kiangah,”Tua ahih leh mi khat in a zi kiangah kimakna lai pia-in a sawlkhiat nadingin bang hangin Mosheh in thupia ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua hi a, ken kong cih mah, pasal dang tawh mawhna hang cih simloh mi khatpeuh in a zi a mak a, tuanu midang tawh a kiten leh tuanu in nu leh pa mawhna a bawl a hi hi. Tua banah, a kimasa numei a tenpih mipa zong nu leh pa mawhna bawl ahi hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite in Ama kiangah, “Nupa thu pen tua bang ahih mawk leh zi neih loh ding hoihzaw hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “ Yahweh in a tuam piakte simloh mi khempeuh in hih thu sang zo lo uh hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh a nu gil sung pan a suah a kipan gehsa mi pawlkhat omin, mihing geh tawm zong om a, Yahweh Kumpigam hangin a zi deih lo zong om hi. Hih thu a sang zote in sang tahen,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in naupangnote tungah a khut nga-in thu a ngetsak theih nadingin Ama kiang naupangnote a kipaipih hi. Ahih hangin nungzuite in a na taii uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Naupangnote phal un, Kei kiang nong pai ding khaktan kei uh. Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh Kumpigam pen tua bang mite aa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in amaute tungah a khut a nga hi. Tua khit ciangin tua mun panin a paisuak hi.

Ahih hangin Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Bang hangin hoihna thu hong dong na hi hiam? Hoihna bukim tehna Khat bek om a, tua in Yahweh ahi hi. Nuntakna sungah na lut nop leh, Yahweh’Thukhamte na zui in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “A koizawte zui ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Yahshua in, “Mi na that kei ding hi. Nulepa mawhna na bawlkei ding hi. Van na gu kei ding hi. A man lo teci na pang kei ding hi.
Na nu leh na pa pahtawi in, a cihteh leh nang leh nang na ki-it bangin na venge na it ding hi, cihte ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tangvalpa in ama kiangah, “Hihte khempeuh ke neu-a kipan ka zuih tohtoh hi a, bang kisam lai ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Yahshua in ama kiangah, “Yahweh sungah micing taktak na uh leh, pai inla, na neihsate zuakin na sehsuah thumna mi zawngte aa dingin pia in; tua ciangin vantung ah sum na nei ding hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh’ ngeinate leh Keima nung hong zui na hi ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua banah ken kong cih inah: Yahweh Kumpigam sungah mihau khat a lut ding sangin phim bilvang sungah kalaoh khat khum ding baihzaw hi,” a ci hi. (Mt 6:24)
A nungzuite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin lamdang sa mahmah uh a, “Tua hileh kua in hotkhiatna ngahzo ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in amaute enin, “Hih pen mihingte tawh a hi thei hilo a, ahih hangin Yahweh tawh na khempeuh hi thei hi” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kepha in dawngin ama kiangah, “ En in, kote in na khempeuh nusia-in, nang kong zui uh hi. Tua hangin bang ngah ding ka hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “ A mantakpi ken kong cih inah: Messiah nungzuite Pahphat hun ah, Mihing Tapa a minthanna kumpi-tokham tungah a tut ciangin, Ka nung hong zui note in Israyl minam sawm le nite thukhenin kumpi-tokhom sawm le nih tungah na tu ding uh hi.
Keima Min hangin a innte, a sanggam pasalte, a sangga numeite, a pa ahih keileh a nu, a tate ahih keileh a leitang a nusia mi peuhmah in a zah zakhat ngah ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin a masa tampite nunung ding a, a nunung tampite masa dingn hi.
Banghang hiam cihleh Yahweh Kumpigam pen a leenggah lo-a nasem ding mi a cial dingin zingsang tuungin a paikhia inn neipa tawh kibang hi.
Amah leh nasemte nitha denarius khat thaw a kithukim khit uh ciangin, amah in a leenggah lo sunga amaute a sawl hi.
Tua khit ciangin a nai thumna; zingsang nai 9:00 pawl ciangin amah paikhia-in, vanzuakna phual ah a mawk dindin mi dangte a mu hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Note zong ka leenggah lo ah va kuan un. Thaman a kilawm zah kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute a pai uh hi.
A nai gukna leh nai kua-na; sunkim leh nitak lam nai 3:00, pawl ciangin amah paikhia leuleu-in, tuamah bangin a cial hi.
A nai sawmlekhat na; nitak nai 5:00, pawl ciangin amah paikhia a, a na mawk omom midangte a muh ciangin amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin sunthapaai hih tengah mawk omom na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Kuamah in ko hong cial lo ahih cianga,” ci uh hi. Amah in amaute kiangah, “Note zong ka leenggah lo ah va kuan un. Thaman a kilawm zah kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua hi a, nitak hong tun ciangin leenggah lo neipa in a thuvaihawmpa kiangah, “Nasemte sam-in, amaute a thaman ciat uh pia inla, a nunung pan panin a masate nunun in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin nitak nai 5 hun pan a cial nasemte hong pai-in, amaute khat ciat in denarius khat ta a ngah uh hi.

“Hih a kuan nunungte in nai khat bek nasem uh a, kote in sun niloh nisa nuai-ah hakkol ka puak uh hangin amau tawh a kikimin nong bawl hi.
Ahih hangin amah in amaute khat kiangah, “ Lawm aw, nang tungah a thumaan loin kon gamta kei hi. Thaman denarius khat piak ding kei tawh a thukim hilo na hi nial?
Na thaman la inla, pai in. A nunungte zong nang tunga kong piak mah bangin ka pia nuam hi.
Ka neihsa ka lungkim bangin ka zek ding kilawm lo a hi hiam? Ka citna hangin bang hangin lungkim lo na hi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin a nunungte masa ding a, a masate nunung ding hi. Tampi kisam a, ahih hangin tawm bek kiteel hi,” a ci hi.
Yerusalem ah Yahshua a pai toh laitakin, amah in a nungzuite lamdung ah tuam paipih-in amaute kiang ah,
“En un, Yerusalem ah a tung to ding i hi ta a, Mihing Tapa kilehhekin siampi liante leh lai-atte tungah kipia ding a, amaute in a kitah nadingin a mawhsak ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Zabdyah’ tapate’ nu a tapate tawh hong pai uh a, Yahshua kiangah nget nop khat nei uh ahih manin ama mai ah a kun hi.
Yahshua in tuanu kiangah, “Bang deih na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tuanu in ama kiangah, “Hih ka tapate nih Na Kumpigam ah khat na taklam ah khat na veilam ah na tutsak ding ka deih hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahshua in, “Nong nget bang hiam cih na thei kei hi,” ci-in dawngin a tapate kiangah, “Ka dawn na ding hai pan na dawn zo ding uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Ka hi zo ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Adang sawmte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin tua unau nihte tungah a lungkim kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in amaute samin, “Gentile mite sungah ukna neite in mipite ukcip u a, a lianzaw laite in mipite tungah thuneihna tawh a ukna thu na thei uh hi.
Ahih hangin note lakah hih bang hi peuhmah lo ding hi. Banghang hiam cihleh note lakah a lian ding peuhmah note’ nasem hi tahen.

En un, lam geiah a tu mittaw nih om a, amaute lamah Yahshua a pai lam a zak uh ciangin, “David’ Tapa, Ukpipa aw, kote hong hehpih in!” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute daih tuak lo uh ahih manin mipite in a taii uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute kiko zaw sem lai uh a, “David Tapa, Ukpipa aw, kote hong hehpih in!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua khawlin amaute sam a, “Note aa ding bang hong sepsak dingin hong deih na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Ukpa aw, ka mitte uh hong honsak in, a ci uh hi.

Yerusalem tun kuan, Olive Mual, Bethphage a tun khit uh ciangin Yahshua in a nungzuite nih sawlin,
amaute kiangah, “Na gal uh a khua ah va pai un, tua ciangin a kikhih laapi khat leh amah tawh a om laano khat na mu pah ding uh hi. A khihna phelin a nihin Ka kiangah hong paipih un.
Mi khatpeuh in thu khatpeuh hong cihleh, note in ‘Siapa in laate zang nuam hi,’ ci un. Tua ciangin amah in hong phal pah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Hih thu khempeuh, kamsangpa tungtawna kigensa thu a tangtun nading a piang ahi hi. A gen inah:

“Zion tanu aw, nakpi-in nuam in! Yerusalem tanu aw, nuamna tawh awngkhia in! En in, na Kumpipa uh hong pai hi. Amah thutangin hotkhiatna nei a, kiniamkhiatin, laapi’ tano, laano apa khat tungah a tuang hi,” a ci hi.

“Yahweh Kumpigam pen a tapa aa dingin mopawi a bawlsak kumpipa tawh kibang hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tua nasemte lamzikpi ah pai-in, a muh zahzah uh misia mipha a vekpi-in a kaikhawm uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mopawi ah leengnate a dim hi.
